What it is

feeling small is a clothing brand I co-created with my friend Caleb (@letscalebrate). It's built around a feeling: recognizing how small we are next to the universe, and taking that as a reason to be more intentional with our time. In summer 2023 we launched our first collection which featured embroidered shirts and a hat.

What I did
  • Co-created the brand and helped drive the mission and design.
  • Specifically helped with the embroidery, working with the embroiderers and getting product to them.
  • Ran the backend: organization, logistics, packing, QC, and shipping orders to customers.
  • Helped run marketing and social media, including the photoshoots (where I also modeled) and the mini vlogs we started near the end.
  • Pitched the clothing brand to collaborates and others within the fashion community.
Result
  • Sold about 80 items.
  • The shop is still up at feeling-small.webflow.io, and the brand is on Instagram at @feelingsmall.me.
